briefdescription.para: Add a pass to the queue of passes to run.

detaileddescription.para: This passes ownership of the Pass to the PassManager. When the PassManager is destroyed, the pass will be destroyed as well, so there is no need to delete the pass. This may even destroy the pass right away if it is found to be redundant. This implies that all passes MUST be allocated with 'new'.

briefdescription.para: createPrinterPass - Get a module printer pass.
run - Execute all of the passes scheduled for execution.

detaileddescription.para: Keep track of whether any of the passes modifies the module, and if so, return true.

briefdescription.para: Pass Manager itself does not invalidate any analysis info.
doInitialization - Virtual method overridden by subclasses to do any necessary initialization before any pass is run.
doFinalization - Virtual method overriden by subclasses to do any necessary clean up after all passes have run.
